title: feat(spec)!: refuse a duplicate identity inside one stack's named collections, 27 keys (#22934)
body:
Fixes #22934
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What this does

`defineStack`'s cross-reference aggregate (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) gains one frozen identity table, `SAME_STACK_ENTRY_IDENTITY`, and one collector, `collectDuplicateEntryErrors`. It is pushed from `validateCrossReferences` before the object-count early return, beside `collectDuplicateActionKeyErrors` and `collectDuplicateFunctionNameErrors`. When two or more entries of one of 27 named collections carry one identity, the stack is refused. There is one finding per (collection, identity) collision, and it names the collection, the identity and every index, in the wording family of the `functions` refusal:

```text
✗ Datasource 'dupe_ext' is declared twice in `datasources`: stack.datasources[0] and stack.datasources[1]. The runtime registers datasources by name, and its two halves disagree on which entry won: the metadata describes the last of these entries while the driver connects with the first one's configuration. Rename one of them, or merge them into a single entry.
```

The envelope is the existing one: `StackCrossReferenceError`, `code: 'STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID'`, `status: 422`, one `issues` entry per finding. Every entry counts, byte-identical twins included. `strict: false` skips it, like every cross-reference check.

The build sheet is stage 0's accepted plan (report `6120008386`, ACCEPT `6120079730`).

## The identity table

| collections | identity | what the boot did with a pair (stage 0, `246edf5b3`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `objects`, `pages`, `dashboards`, `reports`, `datasets`, `flows`, `jobs`, `books`, `positions`, `permissions`, `capabilities`, `sharingRules`, `webhooks`, `mappings`, `analyticsCubes`, `connectors`, `picklists`, `docs`, `tools`, `skills`, `apps` | `name` | kept the last entry on both paths |
| `datasources` | `name` | metadata described the last entry, the driver connected the first one's config |
| `hooks` | `name` | metadata listed one hook, both handlers bound and ran |
| `apis` | `name` | kept the last; the first entry's path answered 404 |
| `emailTemplates` | `(name, locale)`, an untagged entry keyed as `en-US` | kept the last for that locale |
| `views` | the object an aggregated container binds to (`deriveViewContainerObject`); any other entry by its `name` | the container slot kept the last |
| `objectExtensions` | `extend` | only the last extension's fields registered |

Out of the table, each with its reading: `plugins` (declared last-one-wins contract, ruling #9864 B), `agents` (withdrawn for app packages, ADR-0063 §2), `picklistExtensions` (merged by option value in the registry), `actions` (already refused), `functions` (landed in PR #22931).

## FROM → TO, per key

Common to all 27: FROM two entries of `stack.KEY` under one identity accepted by `defineStack` and `os validate` (exit 0, `valid: true`), and the boot kept the last. TO refused by `defineStack` with `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422, naming the key, the identity and every index. One-line fix: rename one entry, or merge the two into one.

| key | FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `objects`, `pages`, `dashboards`, `reports`, `datasets`, `flows`, `jobs`, `books`, `positions`, `permissions`, `capabilities`, `sharingRules`, `webhooks`, `mappings`, `analyticsCubes`, `connectors`, `picklists`, `tools`, `skills` | two entries under one `name` accepted, last wins | refused; rename one, or merge |
| `datasources` | metadata describes the last entry, the engine driver connects the first entry's config | refused |
| `hooks` | metadata shows one hook, both handlers are bound and run | refused; one hook with `object: ['a', 'b']`, or two names |
| `docs` | `os validate` / `os build` refuse (`docs/duplicate-name`), `os serve` from source keeps the last | refused at the contract on every door; the CLI rule keeps the inline-vs-`src/docs` collision |
| `apis` | same name on two paths accepted; the first endpoint is unroutable (404) | refused; give each endpoint its own name |
| `apps` | on a `module` package two apps sharing a name accepted, last wins | refused (the `app`-package single-app count rule is unchanged, and this refusal runs before it) |
| `emailTemplates` | two entries under one name AND one locale accepted, last wins | refused; one name across several locales stays an i18n bundle |
| `views` | two containers for one object accepted, last wins | refused; one container per object, merge `list` / `form` / `listViews` / `formViews` into it |
| `objectExtensions` | two extensions of one target accepted, only the last one's fields register | refused; merge their fields into one extension |

## The view derivation moves into the spec

`deriveViewContainerObject` moves from `packages/metadata/src/view-container.ts` into `packages/spec/src/ui/view-container-object.ts`, a module that imports nothing. It is exported from `@objectstack/spec` (root and `./ui`). `@objectstack/metadata` re-exports that one declaration under the same name, at its root and at `@objectstack/metadata/view-container`. There is one copy, and nothing is removed from `@objectstack/metadata`'s public surface.

- `check:api-surface` moved by one export on `.` and `./ui`, regenerated with `gen:api-surface`; `export-origins/` too, with `gen:export-origins`. Neither was hand-edited.
- The cost, measured on the built tree. `@objectstack/metadata/view-container` used to import nothing. Its CJS entry now loads 98 modules across `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/spec`, `zod` and `pg-connection-string`, because it reaches the spec root entry. For `@objectstack/objectql/core`, `check:lean-entry-closure` holds its admitted set exactly (15 packages; import 203 modules, require 201). Its CJS closure already loaded `packages/spec/dist/index.js` before this edge, through `engine.ts`'s own root import and `view-container-name.cjs`, so the edge adds no module there. The header of `view-container.ts` says this.

## Deviations from the accepted plan, measured

1. **`emailTemplates` is keyed by `(name, locale)`, not `name`.** The spec's own pins (`stack-email-template-locale-floor.test.ts`) author i18n bundles, one name across several locales, and the refusal keyed by name alone turned 4 of them red. The runtime agrees: `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`) keys `email_template` by `(name, locale)`, canonical `en-US`. So 24 keys are keyed by `name`, not 25. The ruling's intent (refuse what the runtime collapses) holds: a same-locale pair still loses, and stage 0's measured pair was same-locale.
2. **`views` entries that are not aggregated containers are keyed by their `name`.** That is the slot every registrar files them under (`resolveMetadataItemName` in `engine.ts`, `artifactItemSlot` in `plugin.ts`, the unmanaged-install validator, the CLI's scaffold wiring). An aggregated container is keyed by its derived object, as planned.
3. **Size: +846 / −88 = 934 changed lines over 16 files**, of which 4 are generated. The plan estimated about +450. The pin file is 417 lines (138 cases), and the collector's table and docblock are about 210.

## Verification record

Base `4e6b27099`; `origin/main` `9432bac07` merged in as `9442d4b7f` (disjoint files: flows / notify-node).

- **A1 re-confirmed** at `4e6b27099` before any edit, by a probe through `defineStack` from source: all 27 keys accepted a same-identity pair.
- **Pin file** `packages/spec/src/stack-duplicate-entry.test.ts`, 138 tests. Per batch key there is one refusal case asserting `name`, `code`, `status`, the issue count, the header and the named subjects (collection, identity, every index). There is also a byte-identical-twin case per key (26; for `apis` a twin repeats METHOD + path, which the endpoint gate already refuses at the parse, pinned as `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`). Further cases: one finding per collision across collections (3 and 2 indices), the object-less stack, two map keys spelling one explicit `name`, a named and an unnamed container bound to one object, two same-named apps on an `app` package, and one envelope joined with the action-key and function-name findings. Controls: distinct identities per key (27), the map form under two keys for the 19 map-supported keys, an email-template i18n bundle, the cross-scope action pair, `plugins` / `agents` / `picklistExtensions` repeated, and `strict: false` per key (27).
- **Ablation of the push line**, committed state `e9e921b5d`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `errors.push(...collectDuplicateEntryErrors(config));` hit 1 → 0, blob `6dd315756e28` → `48864d7b1e4d`). Red: **60 failed / 78 passed** (the 60 refusal cases; every control stayed green). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, anchor back to 1. Green: **138 / 138**. The subject is imported from source (`./stack.zod`), so no `dist/` leg was owed.
- **`@objectstack/spec`** full suite at `9442d4b7f`: **652 files, 19606 passed, 1 todo**. The pre-merge run at `c1c13cbf6` was red on exactly the 4 email-template pins and 2 export-origins freshness cases (deviation 1 above, and `gen:export-origins`); both are fixed. `typecheck` exit 0; `check:generated` exit 0 (14 artifacts up to date).
- **`@objectstack/metadata`** full suite: **58 files, 871 passed**; `typecheck` exit 0.
- **`@objectstack/cli`** `typecheck` exit 0.
- **Consumer radius (PM assumption A2).** Every test file outside the spec that calls `defineStack(` (186 files, 22 packages; 160 of them ran) against a spec `dist/` rebuilt with this change (built at `21d95f9e8`; the spec source it reads is unchanged since, apart from the merged `main` commits). One fixture needed a change, and everything else is green. `cli`: of its 78 files, the 27 in the `unit` tier ran 369 passed and 1 failed, the fixture below, whose file passes 10 / 10 after the change; the 25 in the `integration` tier ran 190 / 190; the 26 `*.e2e.test.ts` files are in neither PR tier and are NOT MEASURED here. `qa/dogfood` 47 files, 347 passed; `runtime` 11, 171; `verify` 14, 135; `objectql` 4, 127; `plugin-security` 5, 103; and 15 more packages, all exit 0. `examples/app-showcase`'s 2 files first failed to resolve the unbuilt `@objectstack/connector-slack`, which is environmental; after building it they pass 45 / 45.
  - **Fixture changed (1):** `packages/cli/src/utils/permission-set-name-collisions.test.ts`, the case "the SAME package declaring its own set name twice is NOT a collision". It authored a byte-identical permission-set twin through strict `defineStack` on purpose, to prove the compile door does not report an intra-package duplicate. Strict `defineStack` now refuses that package, so the case builds it through `{ strict: false }`, and its assertion is unchanged. That shape now reaches the door only from a non-strict stack or an older artifact, which is when the property matters.
  - A static AST scan of every tracked `.ts` under `packages/` and `examples/` (8483 files) for array literals under the 27 keys repeating a literal identity found 19, and none reaches strict `defineStack`. They are `lintConfig` raw inputs in `packages/cli/test/lint-namespace-prefix.test.ts` and `lint-handwritten-checks-package-fold.test.ts`, position rows in `packages/core`, and a `declaredPositionNames` input in `qa/dogfood`.
- **Examples.** At `9442d4b7f`, the four example configs load through the rebuilt spec (`defineStack` accepted, `app-multi-package` with 2 packages). At `e9e921b5d`, `os validate --json` exits 0 on `app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-showcase` and `app-multi-package`, and `os build` exits 0 on `app-crm`, `app-showcase` and `app-multi-package`.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: the families, each exit captured before any pipe, are listed in the report on #22934. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` is **NOT MEASURED**: the dispatch excluded it.

## Acceptance notes

- **`composeStacks` misattributes a same-stack duplicate object** (stage 0). `composeStacks([dupStack, other])` with the default `objectConflict: 'error'` refused with `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` and the text "defined in multiple stacks", because `mergeObjects` keeps one name map across all inputs. This batch removes the authored path to it: a stack carrying the pair no longer leaves strict `defineStack`. `composeStacks`' text is unchanged.
- **`os build`'s duplicate counts and below-warn overwrite notices** (stage 0). The build summary counted duplicates as distinct entries ("2 Datasources", "3 APIs", "2 Picklists"), and the registry's overwrite notices print only above warn, so a default-level boot said nothing. Both disappear once the batch refuses. Nothing in the build or the registry is changed here.
- **ADR-0048 §3.4.** §3.4 leaves an author shipping two `page/home` in one package to authoring-time hygiene, the `naming/namespace-prefix` advisory of `os lint`. This PR refuses that case at the contract instead, for the collections above, as `collectDuplicateActionKeyErrors` already did for actions. §3.4's runtime rules are untouched: cross-package coexistence (`packages[i]` bodies of a `manifest: 'preserve'` project are not read here), and same-package re-registration on reload. A reviewer may judge this a reading of the ADR. It is flagged here, not assumed.
- **`os lint`'s intra-package duplicate advisory** (`duplicateNameIssues` in `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`, covering apps, pages, dashboards, flows, reports and datasets) can no longer fire on a top-level stack that strict `defineStack` built. It stays reachable for `strict: false` stacks and hand-built package bodies. Carrier: none.
- **`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`** imports `deriveViewContainerObject` "from the LEAF subpath". That subpath is no longer a leaf: it now loads the spec root, which this closure already loads. The comment's reason (keep the manager and the filesystem tier out of the lean entry) still holds. Outside this claim's file surface; carrier: the next edit to that import.
